zh: 國防部宣布，現役部隊將在下個月完成年度戰備檢查。
en: The Ministry of National Defense announced that the active component will complete its annual readiness inspection next month.

zh: 這項新編裝計畫主要影響現役部隊的人員配置。
en: The new force structure plan mainly affects the personnel assignments of the active component.

zh: 飛行員在模擬機上反覆演練空中戰鬥的基本戰術。
en: Pilots repeatedly rehearse the basic tactics of aerial combat in the simulator.

zh: 這款戰機的設計重點是提升空中戰鬥時的機動性與反應速度。
en: The design of this fighter focuses on improving maneuverability and reaction speed during aerial combat.

zh: 敵軍空襲前夕，指揮官將防空兵力重新部署到沿海要地。
en: On the eve of the enemy air raid, the commander redeployed the air defense force to key coastal locations.

zh: 防空兵力必須與雷達部隊保持即時的通信聯繫。
en: The air defense force must maintain real-time communication with the radar units.

zh: 第二航空大隊將於明晨起飛執行海上巡邏任務。
en: The Second Air Group will take off tomorrow morning to carry out a maritime patrol mission.

zh: 航空大隊的維修人員必須在出動前完成所有檢查。
en: Maintenance personnel of the air group must complete all inspections before the sortie.

zh: 為了防範突發的空襲，戰機全天候執行空中巡邏。
en: To guard against sudden air raids, fighters conduct air patrols around the clock.

zh: 空中巡邏的航線每週都會依據情報調整一次。
en: The routes of the air patrol are adjusted once a week according to intelligence.

zh: 全民防衛的概念強調平時的教育與全體國民的參與。
en: The concept of all-out defense emphasizes peacetime education and the participation of all citizens.

zh: 政府將在今年度擴大推動全民防衛的宣導工作。
en: The government will expand its all-out defense outreach work this year.

zh: 兩棲突擊舟車載著陸戰隊員從運輸艦直接駛向灘頭。
en: The amphibious assault vehicle carried marines from the transport ship directly to the beachhead.

zh: 新型兩棲突擊舟車的裝甲厚度比舊型增加許多。
en: The armor of the new amphibious assault vehicle is much thicker than that of the old model.

zh: 這個實驗室專門從事武器系統的應用研究。
en: This laboratory specializes in applied research on weapon systems.

zh: 應用研究的經費在預算案中較去年略有增加。
en: Funding for applied research increased slightly in the budget proposal compared with last year.

zh: 步兵班在接近敵陣地時開始實施突擊射擊。
en: The infantry squad began assault fire as it approached the enemy position.

zh: 教官提醒學員，突擊射擊必須保持穩定的節奏。
en: The instructor reminded the trainees that assault fire must be kept at a steady rhythm.

zh: 基地指揮部本部負責統籌整個營區的後勤補給。
en: The base headquarters is responsible for coordinating logistics and supply for the entire camp.

zh: 新任指揮官昨日抵達基地指揮部本部並聽取簡報。
en: The new commander arrived at the base headquarters yesterday and received a briefing.

zh: 基地作業支援包括供電、供水與營區的日常維護。
en: Base operations support includes electricity, water supply, and routine maintenance of the camp.

zh: 承包商將依合約提供基地作業支援服務。
en: The contractor will provide base operations support services under the contract.

zh: 這支部隊的基本任務是確保海上交通線的暢通。
en: The basic mission of this unit is to keep the sea line of communication open.

zh: 無論環境如何變化，守衛國土始終是軍隊的基本任務。
en: No matter how the environment changes, defending the homeland remains the basic mission of the armed forces.

zh: 指揮官向全體官兵重申作戰紀律的基本原則。
en: The commander reiterated the basic principles of combat discipline to all officers and soldiers.

zh: 這份手冊列出了野外生存的基本原則。
en: This manual lists the basic principles of survival in the field.

zh: 該機構的生物研究必須遵守國際公約的規範。
en: The biological research of the agency must comply with the norms of international conventions.

zh: 新的生物研究設施預計明年完工。
en: The new biological research facility is expected to be completed next year.

zh: 多數國家已簽署生物武器公約，承諾不發展生物武器。
en: Most countries have signed the Biological Weapons Convention and pledged not to develop biological weapons.

zh: 專家呼籲各國強化生物武器公約的查核機制。
en: Experts called on countries to strengthen the verification mechanism of the Biological Weapons Convention.

zh: 國防部公布了新版的最高作戰指導構想，供各軍種參考。
en: The Ministry of National Defense released the new Capstone Concept for the services to reference.

zh: 這項演習的設計完全依據最高作戰指導構想。
en: The design of this exercise is based entirely on the Capstone Concept.

zh: 聯戰最高指導構想為未來十年的聯合作戰訂定了方向。
en: The Capstone Concept for Joint Operations sets the direction for joint operations over the next ten years.

zh: 學者研究了聯戰最高指導構想對各軍種教育訓練的影響。
en: Scholars studied how the Capstone Concept for Joint Operations affects education and training in each service.

zh: 這型飛彈採用指揮導引，由地面站持續修正彈道。
en: This missile uses command guidance, with the ground station continuously correcting its trajectory.

zh: 指揮導引的缺點是容易受到敵方電子干擾。
en: The weakness of command guidance is that it is vulnerable to enemy electronic jamming.

zh: 工程師正在測試新的指揮導引系統。
en: Engineers are testing the new command guidance system.

zh: 指揮導引系統一旦失效，飛彈便無法修正航向。
en: Once the command guidance system fails, the missile cannot correct its course.

zh: 敵軍首先攻擊的目標往往是我方的通信節點。
en: The first targets of the enemy attack are often our communication nodes.

zh: 工兵部隊在山區加設了數個通信節點以擴大涵蓋範圍。
en: Engineer units added several communication nodes in the mountains to extend coverage.

zh: 國防情報局提交的報告指出，該地區的軍事活動明顯增加。
en: The report submitted by the Defense Intelligence Agency indicates that military activity in the region has increased markedly.

zh: 國會議員要求國防情報局公開部分評估內容。
en: Members of Congress asked the Defense Intelligence Agency to release part of its assessment.

zh: 守勢制空的任務是攔截並摧毀來襲的敵機。
en: The mission of defensive counterair is to intercept and destroy incoming enemy aircraft.

zh: 空軍把守勢制空列為本年度演訓的重點項目。
en: The air force listed defensive counterair as a key item of this year's exercises and training.

zh: 朝鮮民主主義人民共和國再度發射了彈道飛彈。
en: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea has again launched a ballistic missile.

zh: 聯合國安理會針對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的核試驗召開了緊急會議。
en: The UN Security Council held an emergency meeting on the nuclear test conducted by the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.

zh: 這款無人機仍處於設計階段，尚未進行試飛。
en: This drone is still in the design stage and has not yet been test flown.

zh: 在設計階段就必須納入後續維修的需求。
en: Requirements for subsequent maintenance must be included from the design stage.

zh: 複雜的電磁環境使通信品質大幅下降。
en: The complex electromagnetic environment greatly degraded communication quality.

zh: 演習中，指揮官必須在惡劣的電磁環境下維持指揮。
en: During the exercise, commanders had to maintain command in a harsh electromagnetic environment.

zh: 敵軍在開戰前夕對我方雷達發動電子攻擊。
en: On the eve of the war the enemy launched an electronic attack against our radars.

zh: 電子攻擊的目的是癱瘓對手的指揮與通信。
en: The purpose of electronic attack is to paralyze the adversary's command and communications.

zh: 電子支援措施能夠偵測並定位敵方的雷達訊號。
en: Electronic support measures can detect and locate enemy radar signals.

zh: 這艘軍艦配備了先進的電子支援措施系統。
en: This warship is equipped with an advanced electronic support measures system.

zh: 遠征打擊支隊已從母港出發前往西太平洋。
en: The expeditionary strike group has departed its home port for the Western Pacific.

zh: 遠征打擊支隊結合了兩棲作戰與水面作戰能力。
en: The expeditionary strike group combines amphibious warfare and surface warfare capabilities.

zh: 射控雷達鎖定目標後，飛彈隨即發射。
en: Once the fire control radar locked onto the target, the missile was launched immediately.

zh: 技術人員正在校正這部射控雷達的天線。
en: Technicians are calibrating the antenna of this fire control radar.

zh: 飛航組員在起飛前必須完成簡報與檢查。
en: The flight crew must complete the briefing and checks before takeoff.

zh: 這架運輸機的飛航組員共有五人。
en: This transport aircraft has a flight crew of five.

zh: 取得制空權可以為地面部隊保留充分的行動自由。
en: Gaining air superiority preserves ample freedom of action for the ground forces.

zh: 敵人的封鎖限制了艦隊在海峽的行動自由。
en: The enemy blockade restricted the fleet's freedom of action in the strait.

zh: 步兵班以通用機槍提供持續的火力支援。
en: The infantry squad uses a general purpose machine-gun to provide sustained fire support.

zh: 通用機槍既可架設在三腳架上，也可裝在車輛上。
en: The general purpose machine-gun can be mounted on a tripod or fitted to a vehicle.

zh: 偵察兵發現敵軍空隙後，連長下令立即攻擊。
en: After the scouts found a gap in the enemy lines, the company commander ordered a hasty attack.

zh: 立即攻擊雖然速度快，但缺乏周密的準備。
en: A hasty attack is fast but lacks thorough preparation.

zh: 高機動性多重目標輪行載具在崎嶇地形中仍能維持穩定速度。
en: The high mobility multipurpose wheeled vehicle can maintain a steady speed even on rugged terrain.

zh: 後勤單位購入了二十輛高機動性多重目標輪行載具。
en: The logistics unit purchased twenty high mobility multipurpose wheeled vehicles.

zh: 軍事採購與民間的工業複合體之間存在密切的利益關係。
en: There is a close relationship of interests between military procurement and the civilian industrial complex.

zh: 這個地區已發展成為大型的工業複合體。
en: This region has developed into a large industrial complex.

zh: 假訊息的擴散使資訊環境變得更加複雜。
en: The spread of disinformation has made the information environment more complicated.

zh: 作戰計畫必須考量敵方對資訊環境的控制能力。
en: Operational plans must account for the enemy's ability to control the information environment.

zh: 品管人員先把零件送交檢驗單元進行測試。
en: Quality control personnel first sent the parts to the inspection unit for testing.

zh: 檢驗單元發現這批彈藥有三處不合格。
en: The inspection unit found three nonconformities in this batch of ammunition.

zh: 整體作戰需要陸、海、空三軍密切協同。
en: Integrated warfare requires close coordination among the army, navy, and air force.

zh: 學院課程著重培養學員的整體作戰思維。
en: The academy curriculum emphasizes cultivating integrated warfare thinking in its students.

zh: 最新的情報評估顯示，對方的補給線已經延長。
en: The latest intelligence assessment shows that the opponent's supply line has lengthened.

zh: 情報評估需要綜合多個來源的資料。
en: An intelligence assessment must synthesize data from multiple sources.

zh: 這個國家把內部防衛視為首要的國防任務。
en: This country regards internal defense as its primary national defense task.

zh: 內部防衛包括維持治安與保護關鍵基礎設施。
en: Internal defense includes maintaining public order and protecting critical infrastructure.

zh: 國際原子能總署派員檢查了該國的核設施。
en: The International Atomic Energy Agency sent inspectors to examine the nuclear facilities of the country.

zh: 國際原子能總署呼籲各方保持克制。
en: The International Atomic Energy Agency urged all parties to exercise restraint.

zh: 三軍將在下個月舉行聯合訓練，強化協同作戰能力。
en: The three services will hold joint training next month to strengthen their ability to fight together.

zh: 聯合訓練的科目包括空中支援與後勤運補。
en: The subjects of joint training include air support and logistics resupply.

zh: 新兵在野外課程中學習使用地圖與指北針進行地面導航。
en: Recruits learn to use maps and compasses for land navigation in the field course.

zh: 地面導航的訓練評分包括路線選擇與時間掌握。
en: Evaluation of land navigation training includes route selection and time management.

zh: 輕裝步兵可由直升機快速投送到山區。
en: Light infantry can be quickly inserted into mountainous areas by helicopter.

zh: 這支輕裝步兵部隊擅長在叢林環境中作戰。
en: This light infantry unit specializes in fighting in jungle environments.

zh: 液體推進劑的儲存與運送需要嚴格的安全規範。
en: The storage and transport of liquid propellant require strict safety regulations.

zh: 這枚火箭使用液體推進劑，因此發射前必須加註燃料。
en: This rocket uses liquid propellant, so it must be fueled before launch.

zh: 後勤支援基地設在距離前線兩百公里的後方。
en: The logistics support base is located in the rear, two hundred kilometers from the front line.

zh: 工兵正在擴建後勤支援基地的倉儲設施。
en: Engineers are expanding the storage facilities of the logistics support base.

zh: 機械化步兵搭乘裝甲車輛跟隨戰車推進。
en: Mechanized infantry advanced behind the tanks aboard armored vehicles.

zh: 機械化步兵的機動力遠高於傳統的徒步部隊。
en: The mobility of mechanized infantry is far greater than that of traditional foot units.

zh: 這款無人機可在中等高度長時間滯空。
en: This drone can loiter at medium altitude for a long time.

zh: 敵機改在中等高度飛行，以避開低空雷達。
en: Enemy aircraft switched to flying at medium altitude to avoid low-altitude radar.

zh: 盟國同意向該國提供額外的軍事援助。
en: The allies agreed to provide additional military assistance to the country.

zh: 軍事援助的條件需經國會審查批准。
en: The terms of military assistance must be reviewed and approved by the legislature.

zh: 各三軍軍部必須依國防政策編列預算。
en: Each military department must draw up its budget in accordance with defense policy.

zh: 國防部指示三軍軍部提出年度施政報告。
en: The Ministry of National Defense instructed each military department to submit an annual administrative report.

zh: 洪水期間，軍隊提供了大量的軍事支援。
en: During the flood, the armed forces provided extensive military support.

zh: 這項軍事支援僅限於後勤與運輸。
en: This military support is limited to logistics and transportation.

zh: 任務式指揮鼓勵下級指揮官在命令範圍內自行判斷。
en: Mission command encourages subordinate commanders to exercise their own judgment within the scope of the orders.

zh: 要實施任務式指揮，指揮官必須先讓部屬理解作戰意圖。
en: To practice mission command, a commander must first make sure subordinates understand the intent of the operation.

zh: 機動支援組在災區搭建了臨時通信站。
en: The mobile support team set up a temporary communications station in the disaster area.

zh: 每個機動支援組配有兩名技術人員與一輛工程車。
en: Each mobile support team is assigned two technicians and one engineering vehicle.

zh: 多管火箭發射系統可在短時間內發射大量火箭彈。
en: The multiple-launch rocket system can fire a large number of rockets in a short time.

zh: 砲兵營已完成多管火箭發射系統的換裝訓練。
en: The artillery battalion has completed conversion training on the multiple-launch rocket system.

zh: 網路防護小組日夜監控可疑的連線活動。
en: The network defense team monitors suspicious connection activity day and night.

zh: 加強網路防護是資訊安全政策的核心。
en: Strengthening network defense is at the core of information security policy.

zh: 核武嚇阻的有效性取決於對手是否相信報復能力。
en: The effectiveness of the nuclear deterrent depends on whether the adversary believes in the retaliation capability.

zh: 該國宣布將持續強化其核武嚇阻。
en: The country announced that it will continue to strengthen its nuclear deterrent.

zh: 新型雷達已經具備初步的作業能力。
en: The new radar has attained preliminary operational capability.

zh: 機場遭到攻擊後，空軍迅速恢復了基本的作業能力。
en: After the airfield was attacked, the air force quickly restored its basic operational capability.

zh: 情報分析員正在整理敵方的戰鬥序列。
en: Intelligence analysts are compiling the enemy order of battle.

zh: 戰鬥序列顯示該師下轄三個步兵團與一個砲兵團。
en: The order of battle shows that the division has three infantry regiments and one artillery regiment.

zh: 相列雷達可同時追蹤數十個空中目標。
en: Phased array radar can track dozens of air targets simultaneously.

zh: 驅逐艦的桅桿上裝有四面相列雷達。
en: Four phased array radars are mounted on the mast of the destroyer.

zh: 這艘巡防艦的主要任務是護航商船。
en: The primary mission of this frigate is to escort merchant ships.

zh: 主要任務完成後，部隊才會轉進次要目標。
en: Only after the primary mission is complete will the unit shift to secondary objectives.

zh: 地面站的接收器材每週都要校準一次。
en: The receiving equipment at the ground station is calibrated once a week.

zh: 因為接收器材故障，前進觀測所一度失去聯絡。
en: Because of a failure of the receiving equipment, the forward observation post briefly lost contact.

zh: 直升機機組冒著惡劣天候執行救難任務。
en: The helicopter crew carried out the rescue mission in adverse weather.

zh: 救難任務結束後，所有人員都平安返航。
en: After the rescue mission ended, all personnel returned safely.

zh: 白皮書重新界定了各軍種的任務與使命。
en: The white paper redefines the roles and missions of each service.

zh: 預算審查時，議員詢問空軍的任務與使命是否需要調整。
en: During the budget review, legislators asked whether the roles and missions of the air force need to be adjusted.

zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯向外國廠商採購了新一批防空系統。
en: Saudi Arabia purchased a new batch of air defense systems from foreign manufacturers.

zh: 兩國軍方代表在沙烏地阿拉伯首都舉行會談。
en: Military representatives of the two countries held talks in the capital of Saudi Arabia.

zh: 參謀群連夜修訂了兵力運用計畫。
en: The staff revised the scheme of maneuver overnight.

zh: 兵力運用計畫必須配合火力支援計畫同步調整。
en: The scheme of maneuver must be adjusted in step with the fire support plan.

zh: 反艦飛彈採用掠波飛行以躲避艦艇雷達。
en: Anti-ship missiles use sea skimming to evade ship radars.

zh: 掠波飛行使雷達難以在遠距離發現來襲目標。
en: Sea skimming makes it hard for radar to detect incoming targets at long range.

zh: 兩名資深軍官負責審查這份作戰計畫。
en: Two senior officers are responsible for reviewing this operational plan.

zh: 這位資深軍官曾在多個海外基地任職。
en: This senior officer has served at several overseas bases.

zh: 退伍軍人可以到勤務中心辦理各項手續。
en: Veterans can go to the service center to complete various procedures.

zh: 營區內新設的勤務中心提供洗衣與餐飲服務。
en: The newly established service center in the camp provides laundry and dining services.

zh: 艦岸連接艇可把重型裝備從運輸艦直接送上岸。
en: The ship-to-shore connector can deliver heavy equipment directly from the transport ship to the shore.

zh: 海軍計畫採購更多艦岸連接艇以強化登陸能力。
en: The navy plans to buy more ship-to-shore connectors to strengthen its landing capability.

zh: 這片海域是全球最繁忙的船運航路之一。
en: These waters contain one of the busiest shipping lanes in the world.

zh: 為了保護船運航路，多國海軍展開聯合護航。
en: To protect the shipping lane, several navies launched joint escort operations.

zh: 固體推進劑的優點是結構簡單且能迅速發射。
en: The advantage of solid propellant is its simple structure and its ability to launch quickly.

zh: 工廠正在擴建生產固體推進劑的設備。
en: The factory is expanding the equipment used to produce solid propellant.

zh: 太空戰爭的威脅促使各國重新檢視衛星的防護。
en: The threat of space warfare is prompting countries to re-examine the protection of their satellites.

zh: 學者警告，太空戰爭一旦爆發將影響全球通信。
en: Scholars warn that once space warfare breaks out it would affect global communications.

zh: 特種任務飛機負責偵測電子訊號與通信。
en: Special mission aircraft are responsible for detecting electronic signals and communications.

zh: 空軍新購的特種任務飛機將於下半年交機。
en: The special mission aircraft newly purchased by the air force will be delivered in the second half of the year.

zh: 部隊在戰後轉為執行安定作戰，協助重建地方秩序。
en: After the war the unit shifted to stability operations to help rebuild local order.

zh: 安定作戰需要軍事與地方政府的緊密合作。
en: A stability operation requires close cooperation between the military and local governments.

zh: 支援指揮官有責任依照主官的需求調度資源。
en: The supporting commander is responsible for allocating resources according to the needs of the main commander.

zh: 兩棲作戰中，海軍司令擔任支援指揮官。
en: In an amphibious operation, the navy commander serves as the supporting commander.

zh: 新兵在訓練中心接受為期八週的基本體能課程。
en: New recruits receive an eight-week basic physical fitness course at the training center.

zh: 國防部在南部設立了一座現代化的訓練中心。
en: The Ministry of National Defense established a modern training center in the south.

zh: 教官每週更新一次訓練課目時間預定表。
en: The instructor updates the training schedule once a week.

zh: 因為颱風來襲，訓練課目時間預定表臨時調整。
en: Because of the approaching typhoon, the training schedule was adjusted at short notice.

zh: 衛星進入轉換軌道後，會逐步爬升到預定高度。
en: After the satellite enters the transfer orbit, it will gradually climb to its intended altitude.

zh: 地面控制中心正在計算轉換軌道所需的燃料。
en: The ground control center is calculating the fuel required for the transfer orbit.

zh: 戰時運輸系統必須承受大量軍用物資的調度壓力。
en: In wartime, the transportation system must withstand the pressure of moving large quantities of military supplies.

zh: 這座港口是國家運輸系統的主要轉運站。
en: This port is the main transfer station of the national transportation system.

zh: 無人飛機系統已被廣泛運用於邊境監視。
en: Unmanned aircraft systems have been widely used for border surveillance.

zh: 操作無人飛機系統的人員必須通過專門訓練。
en: Personnel who operate unmanned aircraft systems must complete specialized training.

zh: 民用滾裝客貨輪可以在短時間內運送大量車輛與人員。
en: Civilian Ro-Ro ships can move large numbers of vehicles and personnel in a short time.

zh: 軍方正研究如何徵用滾裝客貨輪，以支援兩棲登陸作戰。
en: The military is studying how to requisition Ro-Ro ships to support amphibious landing operations.

zh: 對方的巡邏艦艇頻繁在我方海域從事灰色地帶襲擾。
en: Their patrol vessels frequently engage in gray zone harassment in our waters.

zh: 灰色地帶襲擾的目的，是在不引發戰爭的前提下消耗對手。
en: The purpose of gray zone harassment is to wear down an opponent without triggering a war.

zh: 灰色地帶行動的特點是始終維持在戰爭門檻之下。
en: Gray zone operations are characterized by staying below the threshold of war at all times.

zh: 國防報告指出，灰色地帶手段可能包括網路攻擊與經濟施壓。
en: The defense report notes that gray zone methods may include cyber attacks and economic pressure.

zh: 部隊將於明晨在港口登船，隨後前往演習海域。
en: The troops will embark at the port tomorrow morning and then proceed to the exercise area.

zh: 登船之前，所有人員都必須完成裝備檢查。
en: Before they embark, all personnel must complete an equipment check.
